hero.title: Customer Pays. You Get Paid. Directly.
hero.description: Stripe Connect Express deposits payments straight to your bank account. No intermediary holding your money. No 30-day payout delays.

body: HABOS provisions Stripe Connect Express accounts per workspace, enabling direct payments to the business owner's bank. Customer pays on the website, Stripe charges, the platform deducts a configurable application fee, and the remainder deposits directly into the owner's bank account. Full and partial refunds flow through Stripe with automatic stock restoration. This is Shopify's model applied to an AI-native platform.
flowCaption: Configurable application fee (default 5%). Revenue flows: Customer → Stripe → HABOS takes fee → remainder deposited to your bank.

benefits.title: 3-click setup
benefits.desc: Connect your Stripe account, complete onboarding (business details, bank info, tax ID), and you're live. Charges enabled, payouts enabled.

benefits.title: Every payment method
benefits.desc: Checkout sessions, invoices, payment links, manual payments, and refunds — all through one integration. Full and partial refunds with automatic stock restoration.

benefits.title: Website → payment → bank
benefits.desc: Customer buys on your HABOS website. Stripe charges their card. Your cut is deposited. The order is tracked. No reconciliation needed.

pricing.heading: How HABOS pricing works
pricing.topUps: Plus workspace top-ups ($100–$1K) for teams that need more AI capacity.

cta.heading: Other platforms hold your money. HABOS sends it to your bank.
